# Muhammad Wasim Arshad

> AI Solution Architect and Engineering Leader in Lahore, Pakistan, with 16+ years of experience building AI-powered healthcare systems, intelligent agents, agentic automation and scalable software platforms.

Canonical profile: https://imwasim.com/

## Professional focus

- Engineering leadership and technical strategy
- Healthcare SaaS, EHR, EMR, eMAR, medical billing, scheduling and workforce management
- Software architecture, microservices, modular monoliths, Clean Architecture, CQRS and event-driven systems
- Cloud and serverless delivery with AWS Lambda and DynamoDB
- AI-assisted requirements, design, development, testing, review and documentation
- Product modernization, scalability, quality engineering and DevOps

## Current role

Muhammad Wasim Arshad is an Engineering Manager at iCareManager. He leads four cross-functional product teams and owns technical strategy, architecture, delivery planning, engineering quality and modernization across healthcare SaaS products.

## Experience

- Engineering Manager, iCareManager — August 2022 to present
- Staff Engineer, iCareManager — March 2018 to August 2022
- Principal Software Engineer, Credibal — May 2015 to March 2018
- Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead, Hashe Computer Solutions — 2014 to 2015
- Senior Software Engineer, Fortsolution — 2011 to 2014
- Software Engineer, ApniMarket.pk — 2010 to 2011

## Core technologies

.NET, C#, Angular, AngularJS, React, React Native, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, PHP, JavaScript, REST APIs, AWS, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQL and MySQL.
